title: Expose executed tool results in llm response/v2
objective: Extend llm/response/v2 so callers can inspect the bounded, ordered results of automatically executed tool calls without changing llm/request/v1 or llm/response/v1.

branch.name: wi-0002-llm-response-tool-results
branch.rationale: The work item is processed as a serial set of scoped commits on the current repository branch; the branch name records the intended change boundary without requiring a topic branch.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* - commit the new work item. Process the new work item, making commits as you go.

scope.name: response-v2-tool-results
scope.description: Expose the existing ToolResult records in the response/v2 envelope, preserve result order across automatic tool rounds, and validate the new closed response contract.
scope.reason: Tool results currently reach the provider transport but are not available to callers after completion, limiting observability and downstream handling.

nonGoals.name: v1-contract-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change llm/request/v1 or llm/response/v1 fields or behavior.
nonGoals.reason: The existing v1 contracts are closed public compatibility boundaries.

nonGoals.name: provider-orchestration-expansion
nonGoals.description: Do not add new provider wire formats, new invocation policies, persistence, live provider calls, or real external tool side effects.
nonGoals.reason: This work item exposes results from the existing bounded orchestration path only.

items.name: response-type-results
items.description: The public response/v2 TypeScript contract and JSON Schema include a required bounded toolResults collection whose entries use the existing ToolResult shape.
items.reason: Consumers need a typed and schema-validated way to inspect executed tool outcomes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: LlmResponseV2 exposes toolResults as a readonly ToolResult collection, response/v2 requires the field, and published response examples validate.

items.name: ordered-result-history
items.description: Automatic completion returns every executed tool result in deterministic call and round order, while pending or non-executing paths return an empty collection.
items.reason: Result order is needed to correlate outcomes with tool calls and to distinguish executed work from pending work.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Deterministic tests prove successful results are retained across one or more rounds in order, manual mode reports no executed results, and tool failures are retained as sanitized error results.

items.name: bounded-compatible-validation
items.description: The new response field remains bounded and does not weaken existing response validation, v1 compatibility, or sensitive-error sanitization.
items.reason: A public observability field must preserve the package's existing closed-contract, safety, and boundedness guarantees.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Typecheck, full provider-free tests, build, response-schema validation, and diff inspection pass; no live provider or real tool side effect is claimed.
